title: A video request on a machine without video models
why: Limits said plainly: check what is installed before promising, do not download anything, and offer what works now. (Assumes this ComfyUI has no WAN video models.)

artist.who: Olu, a video artist with a mid-range laptop GPU.
artist.wants: A short clip of waves whose motion gets warped.
rules: If told that something is missing, ask: what would I need, and is there anything close you can do right now?
Never agree to downloads in this chat: say you will sort that out later.
artist.ends_when: the assistant has said what you would need and what it can do now.

first_message: Can you bend a video too? I'd love a short clip of waves where the motion itself gets warped.
expected: Checks what is installed before promising anything (comfy_status, list_models) instead of starting to build
Says plainly what is missing (the video model files, and what they need in graphics memory) in everyday words
Does not download models, install anything or ask him to restart ComfyUI
Says that bending video models is experimental
Offers what works now, for example a bend animation of a still picture, and says how that differs from a bent video
Keeps it short and in his terms
watch_for: Would he know exactly what to get, and roughly how big it is?
